Question Choices: Convert the mixed number 2 3/4 into an improper fraction.
Hints: Each whole contains denominator-many fractional parts. Count them all; to reverse, divide numerator by denominator.
Solution: Each whole is 4/4. Convert 2 wholes to 8/4, then add 3/4: (2 x 4 + 3)/4 = 11/4. This counts 11 copies of 1/4. Check: 11 = 2 x 4 + 3.

Solution: Each whole is 6/6. Convert 4 wholes to 24/6, then add 1/6: (4 x 6 + 1)/6 = 25/6. This counts 25 copies of 1/6. Check: 25 = 4 x 6 + 1.
